risks.title: False automation (action on stale state)
risks.mitigation: Reconciliation job before send; check canonical status at send time; idempotency keys include state version

risks.title: Wrong contractor selected by ranking
risks.mitigation: recommend_only; show eligibility exclusions; never auto-assign

risks.title: Wrong evidence matched to requirement
risks.mitigation: Human confirm; confidence thresholds; MISMATCH_SUSPECTED blocks

risks.title: Premature compliance status / overclaiming
risks.mitigation: trust_language_governance; scoring_semantics_v1 authority labels; draft_for_review only

risks.title: Notification spam / escalation fatigue
risks.mitigation: Orchestrator throttle; per-event idempotency; escalation caps; preferences

risks.title: Role-boundary leakage
risks.mitigation: Route guards on all mutations; automation notify-only cross-role

risks.title: User distrust from hidden automation
risks.mitigation: Explain why surfaced; show source state; no silent mutations

risks.title: Scheduler duplicate ticks (multi-instance)
risks.mitigation: Mongo job store; heartbeat; idempotency on job side effects

risks.title: Legal overclaiming in AI remediation plans
risks.mitigation: Advisory language only; human approval; legal review of templates
